name: kits_endgame
note: Skyglass Wreck endgame: the shared kits and rules on the set-piece library (SKYGLASS_BOSS_FIGHTS.md 5-6); only AI stats differ between versions. Built by engine/kits.ts.

lib-omen-ring.name: Omen: Ring
lib-omen-ring.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Ring). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-ring.battleDescription: The ground around %user cracks and glows.

lib-omen-binding-ring.name: Omen: Binding Ring
lib-omen-binding-ring.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Binding Ring). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.

lib-omen-rows-a.name: Omen: Rows
lib-omen-rows-a.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Rows). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-rows-a.battleDescription: Two lines across the field begin to glow.

lib-omen-rows-b.name: Omen: Rows
lib-omen-rows-b.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Rows). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-rows-b.battleDescription: Two lines across the field begin to glow.

lib-omen-scatter-a.name: Omen: Scatter
lib-omen-scatter-a.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Scatter). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.

lib-omen-scatter-b.name: Omen: Scatter
lib-omen-scatter-b.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Scatter). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.

lib-omen-lines.name: Omen: Lines
lib-omen-lines.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Lines). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-lines.battleDescription: Thin lines of light fan out from %user.

lib-omen-seal-lines.name: Omen: Seal Lines
lib-omen-seal-lines.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Seal Lines). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-seal-lines.battleDescription: Seal script runs out from %user in four lines.

lib-omen-last-light.name: Omen: Last Light
lib-omen-last-light.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Last Light). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-last-light.battleDescription: The whole field darkens. Three points of skyglass light remain.

lib-omen-last-light-binding.name: Omen: Last Light, Binding
lib-omen-last-light-binding.description: A shared warning mark (Omen: Last Light, Binding). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-last-light-binding.battleDescription: Violet script covers the field. Three points of skyglass light remain.

lib-omen-splash.name: Omen: Splash
lib-omen-splash.description: A minor warning mark (Omen: Splash). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.
lib-omen-splash.battleDescription: %user marks a patch of deck in front of them.

lib-omen-short-line.name: Omen: Short Line
lib-omen-short-line.description: A minor warning mark (Omen: Short Line). Its blast follows on the caster's next turn.

lib-blast-ring.name: Eruption: Ring
lib-blast-ring.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-rows-a.name: Eruption: Rows
lib-blast-rows-a.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-rows-b.name: Eruption: Rows
lib-blast-rows-b.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-scatter-a.name: Eruption: Scatter
lib-blast-scatter-a.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-scatter-b.name: Eruption: Scatter
lib-blast-scatter-b.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-lines.name: Eruption: Lines
lib-blast-lines.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-seal-lines.name: Binding: Seal Lines
lib-blast-seal-lines.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-splash.name: Eruption: Splash
lib-blast-splash.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.

lib-blast-short-line.name: Eruption: Short Line
lib-blast-short-line.description: Shared blast: fires on the hexes its Omen marked.
lib-blast-short-line.battleDescription: A short line of force cuts across the deck.

lib-maw-of-the-deep.name: Maw of the Deep
lib-maw-of-the-deep.description: Core Horror signature (Omen: Last Light): black water and teeth everywhere but the stars; Exposed Seam, x3 damage taken for 1 round.
lib-maw-of-the-deep.battleDescription: Black water and teeth rise from every plank. The mass splits open along a glowing seam.

lib-quench.name: Quench
lib-quench.description: Foundry Warden signature (Omen: Last Light): steam everywhere but the cooled tiles; Cooling Shell, x3 damage taken for 1 round.
lib-quench.battleDescription: %user tips seawater onto the melt. The room explodes in steam.

lib-command-absolute.name: Command Absolute
lib-command-absolute.description: Crowned Captain signature (Omen: Last Light, Binding): everywhere but the stars, a 2-round lock: elemental jutsu sealed, +10 AP per action, Move and Replacement Technique +2 cooldown.

lib-crownfall.name: Crownfall
lib-crownfall.description: Crowned Captain signature (Omen: Lines): crown shards fall along the fan.
lib-crownfall.battleDescription: Shards of the crown fall like blades.

lib-broadside.name: Broadside
lib-broadside.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Rows, set A): the ship's guns fire down the marked rows.

lib-ships-bell.name: Ship's Bell
lib-ships-bell.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Binding Ring): the bell tolls; push 3 and a 1-round lock inside the ring.

lib-lowered-guard.name: Lowered Guard
lib-lowered-guard.description: Shared window: the caster takes x3 damage for 1 round.
lib-lowered-guard.battleDescription: %user lowers their guard for one breath.

lib-chain-hook.name: Chain Hook
lib-chain-hook.description: A weighted chain hooks a target, drags them in and pins them.
lib-chain-hook.battleDescription: %user hurls a weighted chain and drags %target across the deck.

lib-oath-of-stillness.name: Oath of Stillness
lib-oath-of-stillness.description: A binding oath: +2 cooldown on Move and Replacement Technique for 2 rounds.
lib-oath-of-stillness.battleDescription: %user speaks the oath; %target's footing turns to stone.

lib-chart-mark.name: Chart Mark
lib-chart-mark.description: Marks a target on the chart; the crew converge on it.

lib-skyglass-aegis.name: Skyglass Aegis
lib-skyglass-aegis.description: A pane of skyglass forms around an ally.
lib-skyglass-aegis.battleDescription: %user raises a pane of skyglass around %target.

lib-mending-seal.name: Mending Seal
lib-mending-seal.description: A seal that knits wounds and lifts afflictions from an ally.

lib-ward-of-command.name: Ward of Command
lib-ward-of-command.description: The Sealwright's ward on the Captain: heavily reduced damage while she stands.

lib-steady-the-helm.name: Steady the Helm
lib-steady-the-helm.description: The Captain's turn to command: sheds afflictions, takes the wheel and braces for 2 rounds (40% less damage, 40% absorb, cannot be cleared).
lib-steady-the-helm.battleDescription: %user shakes off every hold on him and takes the wheel. "I have held this deck through worse than you."

hunt-stonebound-erupting-ground.name: Erupting Ground
hunt-stonebound-erupting-ground.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off. (Skyglass copy: damage hits enemies only.)
hunt-stonebound-erupting-ground.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

dg-raise-the-gunwale.name: Raise the Gunwale
dg-raise-the-gunwale.description: A barrier line of timber and seals; it has its own health.
dg-raise-the-gunwale.battleDescription: %user barks an order; the gunwale rises.

_9k7kSYUgMtB-AEFgRly5.name: Windlash Focus
_9k7kSYUgMtB-AEFgRly5.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
_9k7kSYUgMtB-AEFgRly5.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

UnQKfwq_JoRVu10aTX6Uv.name: Tide Bolt
UnQKfwq_JoRVu10aTX6Uv.description: Shared pool record EW01. Balance values pending sign-off.
UnQKfwq_JoRVu10aTX6Uv.battleDescription: %user draws water from the air into a dense bead of chakra between their fingers. They flick it at %target, and it strikes with the force of a hurled stone.

FeYnH7BBw_usnc1K-TM-J.name: Quick Strike
FeYnH7BBw_usnc1K-TM-J.battleDescription: %user darts in with a compact strike, quick as a swallow, aimed at an opening in %target's guard. The welt it leaves flares hot under every blow that follows, and the rush of the hit sharpens %user's own attacks.

T3glZGcSd-jS8G-NB43GR.name: Counter Stance
T3glZGcSd-jS8G-NB43GR.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
T3glZGcSd-jS8G-NB43GR.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

1jXfTgrtGUaSfqTPSSa83.name: Rigging Snare
1jXfTgrtGUaSfqTPSSa83.description: Seal-threaded rigging lashes the target and briefly pins them in place.
1jXfTgrtGUaSfqTPSSa83.battleDescription: %user lashes seal-threaded rigging at %target, the lines snapping shut around their footing.

3v9c1SHlD2GLPF2HW1_Sc.name: Twin Kunai
3v9c1SHlD2GLPF2HW1_Sc.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

mOA1hXNf4CcuwOhnnN7ZK.name: Springguard
mOA1hXNf4CcuwOhnnN7ZK.description: Shared pool record EW03. Balance values pending sign-off.
mOA1hXNf4CcuwOhnnN7ZK.battleDescription: %user gathers a cool spring of chakra around themselves, like water rising in a well. Blows that strike them are drawn in and turned into vitality.

xGVqWSX93hXZgfmlKZODp.name: Raijin's Spear
xGVqWSX93hXZgfmlKZODp.description: Shared pool record EL04. Balance values pending sign-off.
xGVqWSX93hXZgfmlKZODp.battleDescription: %user shapes a concentrated spear of lightning chakra that hisses and spits in their grip. They drive it cleanly through %target, the point piercing every defense in its way.

Nrxc8m9utE9qaD_gWpLgf.name: Shuriken Storm
Nrxc8m9utE9qaD_gWpLgf.battleDescription: %user fans a handful of shuriken between their fingers and loosens them in rapid succession. They whistle past %target's guard from every angle and leave deep cuts that keep bleeding.

m-ur3A8TS8r5jGb84L9x7.name: Numbing Senbon
m-ur3A8TS8r5jGb84L9x7.battleDescription: %user flicks a senbon needle, its tip glinting, into a nerve point on %target. The strike can lock their muscles for a moment and leave them staggered.

Cw51Wm_Uy0GiIkiEjlQtn.name: Opening Strike
Cw51Wm_Uy0GiIkiEjlQtn.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
Cw51Wm_Uy0GiIkiEjlQtn.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

YiRdVytsdxFzZtqkEDs5Q.name: Weakening Strike
YiRdVytsdxFzZtqkEDs5Q.description: Shared pool record S27. Balance values pending sign-off.
YiRdVytsdxFzZtqkEDs5Q.battleDescription: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

PdD44PGaNv4MN5fOALhAF.name: Keelbind
PdD44PGaNv4MN5fOALhAF.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
PdD44PGaNv4MN5fOALhAF.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

LQ26G2ANWkbTRL7Ry__F0.name: Split Image
LQ26G2ANWkbTRL7Ry__F0.description: Shared pool record B06. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
LQ26G2ANWkbTRL7Ry__F0.battleDescription: %user weaves the Ram seal and presses chakra into the earth at their side. A second %user rises from it, identical down to the dust on their tabi, and steps into the fight.

STu1VHNcfgeC3x-UiQDgt.name: Second Wind
STu1VHNcfgeC3x-UiQDgt.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
STu1VHNcfgeC3x-UiQDgt.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

nOYLPmN3TXj6wEe_oE6HQ.name: Sovereign Undertow
nOYLPmN3TXj6wEe_oE6HQ.description: Shared pool record B03. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
nOYLPmN3TXj6wEe_oE6HQ.battleDescription: %user plunges a hand into the earth and twists, turning the ground beneath %target into a dragging current of chakra. Before they can brace, %target is hauled across the battlefield like driftwood in a flood.

pUrUJX8Jml7fUIBXKsPwv.name: Heavy Strike
pUrUJX8Jml7fUIBXKsPwv.battleDescription: %user plants their feet, twists from the hips, and puts their whole weight behind one heavy strike. It lands on %target with a crack that echoes across the field.

LiVOnYq6qHzjB0XkIIA2e.name: Venom Strike
LiVOnYq6qHzjB0XkIIA2e.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
LiVOnYq6qHzjB0XkIIA2e.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

MG9ZujAV8lK7--YxThVbQ.name: Battle Trance
MG9ZujAV8lK7--YxThVbQ.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
MG9ZujAV8lK7--YxThVbQ.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

X2P22h8ApDmTZHjWpNO87.name: Final Command
X2P22h8ApDmTZHjWpNO87.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
X2P22h8ApDmTZHjWpNO87.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

0Y10JpChssDwFUxNRk6p3.name: Unbroken Command
0Y10JpChssDwFUxNRk6p3.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
0Y10JpChssDwFUxNRk6p3.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

VuFuBtE7h5B1nnA2J1lFZ.name: Stolen Form
VuFuBtE7h5B1nnA2J1lFZ.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
VuFuBtE7h5B1nnA2J1lFZ.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

ddbIyVtoxdPQwLRXxSBq8.name: Suppression Writ
ddbIyVtoxdPQwLRXxSBq8.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
ddbIyVtoxdPQwLRXxSBq8.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

1OhP0StX4VTsosWtCxhsG.name: Unraveling Strike
1OhP0StX4VTsosWtCxhsG.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
1OhP0StX4VTsosWtCxhsG.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

o-4SCAhJ4LHdCwcBDgJrV.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
o-4SCAhJ4LHdCwcBDgJrV.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
o-4SCAhJ4LHdCwcBDgJrV.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

RPdeeWhFI5AIUUpJXwUlf.name: Sovereign Fetters
RPdeeWhFI5AIUUpJXwUlf.description: Shared pool record B16. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
RPdeeWhFI5AIUUpJXwUlf.battleDescription: %user hurls chains of chakra that wrap %target from shoulder to ankle and crush tight. The bindings leave them stunned and seal away their bloodline while the links hold.

JWZYiHKPNwYziWEFjw4Fn.name: Dispelling Wave
JWZYiHKPNwYziWEFjw4Fn.description: Shared pool record B32. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
JWZYiHKPNwYziWEFjw4Fn.battleDescription: %user forms the Ram seal and releases a cold pulse of chakra across the field. Every enhancement wrapped around %target and those beside them is stripped away in an instant.

nCQETf-HNnbRec1OSY2-R.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.
nCQETf-HNnbRec1OSY2-R.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
nCQETf-HNnbRec1OSY2-R.name: Core Rupture
